run_transformer_forward_pass: run the Gemma Transformer forward pass with token inputs to get predicted logits and cache
init_transformer_kv_cache: initialize the Transformer KV cache with a given batch size, dtype, and cache length
encode_vision_embeddings: encode preprocessed vision input patches into embeddings that merge with text token embeddings
encode_audio_embeddings: encode raw audio waveforms through the conformer encoder and project into text embedding space
create_preprocessed_vision_input: create a PreprocessedVisionInput dataclass with image patches, positions, and soft token counts
